summary: Hong Kong-incorporated Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Extraordinary General Meeting on October 29, 2026 approved all resolutions. Holders ratified a 40-for-1 share consolidation, effective October 23, 2026, reducing par value economics from US$0.0000625 to US$0.0025 per share, with fractional shares rounded up; they also ratified amended articles and an authorized share capital increase from US$312,500 to US$12,500,000. Votes were overwhelmingly in favor (1,294,500,069 for, 30,150 against). No price, premium, or deal terms apply; this is a routine capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation.
